steps: Receive and formally register the High Court's order from the High Court Registry/Government Pleader's Office.
Issue an internal circular/memo acknowledging receipt and bringing the order to the notice of all relevant sections and departments.
Send a formal acknowledgement to the High Court Registry for official record, if deemed necessary.
documents_required: High Court Order (Certified copy of the final order/judgment)

steps: Obtain a certified true copy of the High Court's order from the High Court Registry.
Draft a formal covering letter/memo addressed to the Presiding Officer, Labour Court, Thane.
Dispatch the certified copy of the High Court's order along with the covering letter to Labour Court, Thane, ensuring timely delivery within 14 days of the High Court order.
Secure proof of dispatch and delivery (e.g., postal receipt, courier acknowledgement, or official stamp on dispatch copy).
documents_required: Certified True Copy of High Court Order
Draft covering letter to Labour Court, Thane
Delivery acknowledgment from Labour Court, Thane

steps: Prepare a formal communication (e.g., letter or circular) to the Presiding Officer, Labour Court, Thane.
Explicitly convey the High Court's directive to strictly adhere to legal principles and merit-based analysis for Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014.
Clearly instruct the Labour Court to exclude any non-binding prior observations, as per the High Court's order.
Dispatch this communication to the Labour Court, Thane.
documents_required: Draft communication to Labour Court, Thane

steps: Draft a formal letter to the Presiding Officer, Labour Court, Thane, instructing them to prioritize Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014.
Inform the Labour Court of the High Court's expectation for disposal of the case within six months from their receipt of the High Court's order.
Request the Labour Court to take all necessary measures, including appropriate resource allocation, to ensure expeditious disposal of the case.
Dispatch this communication to the Labour Court, Thane.
Monitor the progress of the case in coordination with the Labour Department.
documents_required: Draft communication to Labour Court, Thane
Periodic status reports from Labour Court (if requested)

steps: Prepare a formal letter of inquiry to the High Court Registry.
Specifically request official confirmation that the Rule related to the writ petition has been formally discharged and all pending interim applications have been disposed of.
Dispatch the inquiry letter to the High Court Registry.
Upon receipt of official confirmation from the High Court Registry, update the department's internal case records and legal database.
Circulate the confirmation internally to all relevant sections and externally to any other government departments that were party to the writ petition.
documents_required: High Court Order copy (for reference in the inquiry)
Draft inquiry letter to High Court Registry
Official confirmation letter/document from High Court Registry
Internal file note/memo for records update
